text:
sara: Quick sync — trying to lock the launch windows and announce cadence for H100 / H200 / B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Need embargo ranges and any last-minute capacity caveats so we can finalize the fallback matrix and marketplace SKU mapping by EOW.

mike: Are we still treating H100 as primary for enterprise workloads and MI300 as the main fallback? :thinking:

anil: That’s the plan right now but H200 availability could shift our priorities. Vendors: can you confirm ETAs + requested embargo windows? @vendor-nvidia @vendor-amd

vendor-nvidia: Nvidia update: H100 GA target 2026-06-15. Requested embargo window (internal): 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-16. H200 remains TBD — thermal derate testing ongoing, may slip by ~2–4 weeks.

jen: Noted. Can we get B200 included as a low-cost burst SKU in the mapping? We need rough perf/cost numbers to decide where it lands in the routing policy.

nate: Marketplace: we need canonical SKU tags. Proposed draft mapping to start discussion:
```
sku_matrix = {
  "h100": ["redwood-h100-48g-v1"],
  "h200": ["redwood-h200-80g-v1"],
  "b200": ["redwood-b200-burst-1"],
  "mi300": ["redwood-mi300-1024g-v1"],
  "gaudi": ["redwood-gaudi-1","redwood-gaudi-1b"]
}
```
I'll sync with marketplace infra to lock tags, but want vendor confirmation on canonical names.

ryan: Ops notes / fallback routing proposal (high level):
- Primary by region preference and SLA tier: H100 > MI300 > Gaudi > B200 (burst).
- If thermal/capacity fail, route to next compatible model and apply quantization profile as needed.
- Trace token-level cost delta and surface in Console per-request so product teams can see impact.

anil: Ops action: add canary image label `canary-gpu-fallback=v1` and run canary for 48h before any announce. Also add a graceful-degrade test to lab matrix.

vendor-amd: AMD update: MI300 GA still on track for 2026-05-20. Requested embargo: 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-21. We'll deliver a driver hotfix by 2026-05-05 to address stability on longer sequences.

sara: Perfect. Action items I'll capture: 1) Vendors confirmed embargo ranges (vendor-nvidia, vendor-amd) — done. 2) eng-runtime (ryan) to create a fallback-routing doc + test plan. 3) marketplace (nate) to lock SKU tags and mapping. 4) comms (jen) to draft a joint-announce plan stub and embargo language by EOD Friday.

mike: Small ask from infra: add a "graceful-degrade" CI job to force H100->MI300 transitions under load, verify latency percentiles and KV cache correctness.

ryan: Will schedule a 3h lab runway next Tue and add the graceful-degrade job to CI. I'll post the job spec in #eng-runtime when created.

release-bot: [deploy-notice] Canary runs scheduled: 2026-05-25T02:00:00Z — will include thermal derate and fallback routing smoke tests.

jen: I'll start the PRD + comms draft now. If anyone wants to be on the announcer list, ping me and I’ll include you on the stakeholder thread.

sara: Great — I'll compile a one-pager with embargo/calendar and the fallback priority matrix and ping PMs + marketing. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
